name: Apple Foundation Models
description: Runs Apple's on-device Foundation Models (via /usr/bin/fm serve) on a paired macOS 27 node and exposes it to agents as the apple_fm tool.

socketPath.description: Unix socket for the private fm serve process. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/apple-fm/fm.sock.

defaultMaxTokens.description: Default max_tokens when the caller does not pass maxTokens.
